blinding_guess.why: numpy.matrix enforces a 2-D shape only in __new__ and __array_finalize__ (defmatrix.py:115-187) and defines no resize of its own, so matrix.resize is the inherited in-place ndarray.resize (methods.c:1188), which does not pass through __array_finalize__; a matrix can apparently be resized to a non-2-D shape, which breaks the class invariant.
